title: Nested arithmetic selection through strict proper/open image
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of the l-adic field ℚ_l, c a compactification of X → Y, e,h ≥ 1, and K an arbitrary derived constant E-integral strict tower on X. The image of the retained-level reassociation h then e → h*e followed by inverse selection through image at h*e equals inverse selection through image at e on the h-selected K, then e-selection of inverse selection through image at h, then retained-level reassociation on the image. There is one coefficient field, no scalar extension, no reduction calculus and no support model. The notation is fixed by [lem-pur-compact-support-strict-scalar-composition-prelude], [def-pur-constant-scalar-tower-mates], [def-pur-strict-scalar-mate-evaluation-data].

proof.text: Normalize reindexProper using rightDerivedExactRestriction_normalization, exactly for its published composite of derived comparisons. The ordinary proper-selection squares are identities; functoriality of eqToHom gives their cocycle. Prove the pasted derived square is unit-normalized by expanding the two factorization isomorphisms, moving the middle factor with naturality, and applying the two normalization equations. Apply normalized_naturality to this pasted square and the direct square, using the cochain-factorization formulas for exactDerivedRestrictionComposition. Take components and invert the resulting isomorphism equation.

For open extension take the component of the public equality mapDerivedCategorySquareIso_comp applied to the same ordinary identity-square cocycle. The inverse derived compositor is exactly compositionRetained.inv by mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_symm. The elementary formula for localization of the inverse square follows by expanding its three isomorphism factors. Cancel the two inverse compositors to obtain inverse open-selection composition.

Expand inverse reindexImage into proper image of inverse open selection followed by inverse proper selection. Apply the open composition equation under proper image, then the proper composition equation. Naturality of the proper e-selection comparison moves the intermediate open h-selection map through it. Associativity and functoriality give the whole-image equation.

lean.statement:
theorem reindexImage_composition {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (c : Compactification f) (e h : ℕ) (he : 1 ≤ e) (hh : 1 ≤ h)
    (K : Derived (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) X) :
    (image l E c).map ((compositionRetained l E X e h he hh).hom.app K) ≫
        (reindexImage l E c (h * e) (one_le_mul hh he)).inv.app K =
      (reindexImage l E c e he).inv.app ((subsequence l E X h).obj K) ≫
        (subsequence l E Y e).map ((reindexImage l E c h hh).inv.app K) ≫
        (compositionRetained l E Y e h he hh).hom.app ((image l E c).obj K)
